'''2005 Utah Young Jedi State Championship''' was a [[Young Jedi]] state championship that [[Scott Church]] announced on 1 June 2005 for 11 June at Dragon's Keep in Provo, Utah, to be run alongside the ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship. It was to start at 1 pm with Young Jedi packs as prizes; the entry fee was still to be set.<ref name="pcf-5734-80424">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=80424#80424 Looking for Young Jedi Reflections], Scott Church (scottchurch), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618061012/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5734&start=0 Internet Archive]</ref>
